description: The plot illustrates the training loss versus steps for different model types and sizes, with a dataset size of 20 million. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 400,000 with a tick label interval of 100,000. The y-axis is labeled "Training Loss" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with a tick label interval of 0.2. There are multiple lines in the plot, each representing a different model type and size, with varying colors and line styles, showing a decreasing trend in training loss as the number of steps increases, with some lines starting at around 0.7 and ending at around 0.1, while others start at around 0.6 and end at around 0.2, with some lines exhibiting a more rapid decline in training loss than others.
